result.requirement: The system shall continuously reconcile platform revenue shares against store partner settlements in real-time.
result.business_need: This ensures financial accuracy and trust between the platform and store partners by immediately identifying and resolving discrepancies in revenue distribution.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically ingest financial transaction records and store partner agreement terms to calculate expected revenue shares.
The system shall compare calculated revenue shares against actual settlement amounts generated by the payment provider.
The system shall generate a financial transaction record flagging any detected discrepancies for immediate review.
The system shall update the status of the reconciliation process to reflect resolved or pending items.
The system shall provide a real-time view of reconciliation health to the platform operator and store partner.
related_information_requirements: Real-time status of data link integrity between store POS and platform
Legally binding contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules
Complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, fees, and net settlement amounts
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance affecting delivery fees
Current validated quantity of sellable items at specific store locations
business_rules: A discrepancy is flagged if the calculated revenue share differs from the settlement amount by more than zero.
Reconciliation status must update to 'Resolved' only after the discrepancy is corrected and verified.
Revenue share calculations must strictly adhere to the commission rates defined in the active Store Partner Agreement.
Settlement amounts must include all applicable taxes, delivery fees, and platform commissions as per the Financial Transaction Record.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new order is completed and the Payment Provider confirms the transaction.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the financial data against the Store Partner Agreement.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates the revenue share and updates the Financial Transaction Record within seconds.

acceptance_criteria.given: The calculated revenue share does not match the settlement amount due to a data sync error.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the discrepancy during the real-time reconciliation cycle.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Financial Transaction Record as 'Discrepancy Detected' and notifies the Platform Operator.
